R1/R2/R3 benchmark ran for real on 2026-10-20 (docs/PHASE4_3_VERIFICATION_ZH.md); the official MATLAB MCP server is reachable over stdio. PARTIAL on the benchmark entry is deliberate: the task scripts are fixed, so it does not yet measure an agent's own skill selection or recovery. Phase 4.5 changed no mas_* tool status, so those counts were unchanged; it added the autonomousExecution block and recorded R1/R2/R3 as UNKNOWN/BLOCKED instead of measured. Phase 5.3 added the four matlab-signal-vision-ai measurement tools verified by test_signal_contract.m 42/42, the seven matlab-data-analysis verification tools verified by test_data_contract.m 118/118, and the four robotics contract tools verified by test_robotics_contract.m 162/162 alongside test_robotics.m 31/31. The Phase 5.3 full regression was 644/644 skill tests over 22 suites, 15/15 references, 15/15 cross-domain tasks and 15/15 pipeline tasks with 0 errored suites; it also ran the isolated benchmark harness 11/11 and a tool-level held-out baseline 9/9. Phase 5.4 added mas_ode_check verified by test_ode_contract.m 56/56 and mas_seg_check/mas_detect_check/mas_image_contract verified by test_vision_contract.m 103/103; the isolated benchmark gained six tool-level ODE/vision tasks (2 normal, 2 boundary, 2 fault) graded 6/6 with 0 false accepts and 0 false rejects, and a real agent episode ran 3/3 normal holdout tasks through the MATLAB MCP with grading on the evaluation side. Tool-level results are not agent-level results, and 6/6 new-domain tasks are not a full-domain success rate. Phase 5.5 ran the first genuinely executed R1/R2/R3 comparison on an identical prompt and budget: all three arms passed the one task run in every arm, so no gain was measured. The R3 full-skill arm then executed all 12 holdout tasks with 10 graded passes, 0 false accepts, 0 false rejects and 4 of 5 UNDETERMINED expectations detected. Client-native Skill triggering appeared in 0 of 14 audited episodes, while workspace-level autonomous discovery of the matching skill happened in 9 of 12 R3 episodes and 9 of 12 executed a mas_* contract tool. An adversarial probe proved that grader isolation is not enforced by the client, so the benchmark stays procedural plus post-hoc transcript audited. Phase 5.6 sealed the answers only after every episode (two-phase publish/commit/seal, 22/22 self-test), ran 9 of 27 planned episodes of a frozen 3x3x1 design with four separately reported labels (correctnessPass R1 0/3, R2 2/3, R3 3/3; withinBudget, taskCompleted and deliveryValid 3/3 in every arm), and still found no native Skill invocation (0 of 12). Strong isolation stays BLOCKED (11 of 11 adversarial vectors reached), so the pair differences are reported as observations, not as a causal gain. Full gate 894/894 over 29 suites. Phase 5.7 audited four clients read-only and found every copied tree drifted (qoder 2 current/7 drifted, codex-cli and codex-desktop 5/4 each, workbuddy 0/9) with no install root modified; Qoder reads .qoder-cn/skills while both Codex clients read .agents/skills. It added mas_skill_install_audit (test_skill_install_audit.m 25/25) and mas_delivery_check (test_delivery_check.m 93/93), rescored the unchanged Phase 5.6 results under protocol v2 (v1 0/0/0 -> v2 R1 0/3, R2 2/3, R3 3/3, route/tool NOT_REQUIRED) without altering inputs or v1 files, reached 26 of 26 leak surfaces so strong isolation and Task 5 stay BLOCKED, and pinned the Coder entry contract (file-name string PASS; function handle FAIL at codegen with a diagnostic; real link failure FAIL at build with a byte-exact compiler log). Concurrency isolation was verified for 2 processes over 3 rounds; the 4-process round is EXPLORATORY only. Full gate 1075/1075 over 32 suites.

mas_codegen_ready.what: blocker vs warning audit; loop-depth tracking, not a regex grep; resolves a full file path as well as a function name

mas_codegen_verify.what: real codegen -> MSVC build -> both run -> compare, five stages reported

mas_fixpt_range.what: observed range + SQNR + overflow FRACTION; SKIP without Fixed-Point Designer

mas_ctrl_analyze.what: all 0dB/-180 crossings, unwrapped phase, worst margin not first

mas_ctrl_aw_sim.what: three anti-windup modes incl. back-calculation divided by Ki

mas_ctrl_pid_design.what: max bandwidth subject to a margin constraint; feasible=false when impossible

mas_table_audit.what: row ledger: balanced = nIn == nOut + nDropped, each row judged once

mas_route.what: weighted router with schema 1.1; CLARIFY/AMBIGUOUS instead of guessing, BLOCKED for unavailable skills/toolboxes/dependencies, dependency-first load order

mas_ekf_check.what: NEES/NIS consistency with a two-sided chi-square band

mas_frame_check.what: SE(3)/SO(3) hygiene; orthErr and det reported separately

mas_kin_check.what: planar n-R FK; analytic vs central-difference Jacobian element-wise

mas_kin_ik.what: DLS + step clamp + joint limits; reports raw and clamped step

mas_quat_check.what: unit norm, double cover, axis/angle canonicalisation, composition vs matrix product, shortest-arc SLERP vs closed form; toolbox cross-check is na, never faked

mas_traj_check.what: waypoints, sampled vs certified velocity/acceleration limits, analytic derivative vs 5-point interior stencil, time base; non-uniform/too-short records UNDETERMINED

mas_dyn_check.what: M symmetric/PD and rebuilt from kinetic energy, C via Lagrange identity and skew symmetry, g via potential gradient, RK4 energy conservation of the graded model

mas_estimate_check.what: recorded truth/est/P consistency: mean and per-step NEES bands, run/step gates, covariance hygiene, bias, family-wise innovation whiteness

mas_dep_probe.what: five-level dependency discovery, 8 named states, built-ins pinned, UAV resolved, and a probe that rescues a wrong feature name

mas_precheck.what: 8 cheap checks; toolbox delegates to mas_dep_probe

mas_product_map.what: product<->license feature table incl. historical names

mas_toolbox_map.what: thin wrapper kept for backward compatibility

mas_image_metrics.what: IoU/Dice/P/R/F1 plus per-object matching by argmax over truth labels

mas_ofdm_ber.what: OFDM+QPSK chain vs erfc; per-point counting-noise tolerance reported, verdict now comes from mas_stat_verdict so a zero-error point at high Eb/N0 is UNDETERMINED instead of FAIL

mas_spectrum_check.what: leakage, concentration, Parseval against the WINDOW-WEIGHTED power

mas_split_seed.what: reproducible stratified split with leak assertions

mas_measure_contract.what: grades claimed freq/power/peak/rms against the record they came from; four-state checks (pass|fail|na|undetermined), units checked both ways, missing criterion -> UNDETERMINED

mas_filter_check.what: dual-route response (freqz vs direct z-expansion), pole stability, worst-over-band stopband, ripple, FIR linear-phase group delay; IIR phase is na, not fail

mas_sample_check.what: Nyquist margin with printed fold, peak vs claimed band, bandlimited reconstruction vs analytic truth; no truth -> no pass

mas_ber_check.what: Eb/Es convention (3.01 dB trap), z-test vs theory, Wilson interval, Poisson zero-error bound, resolution gate -> UNDETERMINED

mas_stat_verdict.what: five-state flow for counted/statistical claims (sufficient-support / sufficient-refutation / insufficient-sample / interval-straddles-target / criterion-missing); the state decides the verdict

mas_seg_check.what: pixel contingency with an independent recount; per-class IoU/P/R/F1 and macro with support; 4-connected object matching at an explicit IoU, duplicates as false positives; empty conventions; imbalance disclosure; threshold provenance and sweep

mas_detect_check.what: score-ordered one-to-one matching at a required IoU threshold, duplicate boxes are FP, all-point AP and mAP over classes with GT, box bounds, label-alignment warning, threshold provenance, score sweep

mas_image_contract.what: size/class/range/channels, label alignment, invertible normalization, affine invertibility and point/bounds agreement, edge/feature F1 vs independent truth, split leakage by index+hash+group, tuning/threshold leaks

mas_bench_record.what: R1/R2/R3 ledger; SKIP can never become PASS, UNKNOWN never collapses to SKIP

mas_refcheck.what: freeze/verify with SHA-256; two tamper attacks caught

mas_verify_task.what: grades NUMBERS against the frozen manifest; never reads the task verdict

mas_capability_check.what: keeps the matrix honest: every mas_*.m must be listed, owners must match disk, summary counts must be derived, and every VERIFIED claim must cite a test file or a graded task id

mas_skill_install_audit.what: read-only audit of what each client actually installed and discovered; a root that exists is not a root the client loads, and no client's discovery rule is applied to another

mas_delivery_check.what: checks the delivery envelope (schema, enums, units, required fields, legal UNKNOWN/UNDETERMINED) independently of the engineering numbers; a format error never rewrites the verdict

mas_skill_graph.what: builds the skill call graph from routing.json + SKILL.md + cross-skill script calls; detects cycles, dangling routes, duplicate loading; the detector is pinned against 8 graphs with known answers

mas_skill_audit.what: five-stage skill audit (DISCOVERED/LOADED/SELECTED/WORKFLOW/ACCEPTED); a stage with no evidence stays UNOBSERVED, never silently OK

mas_phase43_grade.what: grades R1/R2/R3 runs against the frozen references; reads only the MAS_RESULT line, never the task's own verdict; a missing result is ERROR, not FAIL

mas_stability_verdict.what: three answers kept separate: math stability, engineering target, evidence quality; rejects a label when no source produced a usable value

mas_dist_enter.what: walks change -> plant receipt -> output/state effect -> timing -> independent prediction; insensitive outputs require internal-state evidence

mas_quad_check.what: two independent reference routes with an agreement gate; claimed tolerance below the roundoff floor -> UNDETERMINED; order measured from n/2n/4n (Simpson-on-kink FAILS); derivative vs central differences

mas_linsolve_check.what: backward error vs 10*n*eps, forward bound kappa*eta, QR cross-route, rank and conditioning gates

mas_converge_check.what: order and rate measured above the roundoff floor; fewer than three clean estimates -> UNDETERMINED; divergence and stagnation FAIL

mas_fit_check.what: coefficients vs QR, R2/RMSE/SE/CI recomputed, t quantile from betainc (no toolbox), zero-dof and conditioning gates, holdout RMSE

mas_stat_check.what: t p-value via betainc, Welch two-sample, CI, exact sign-flip / label-permutation agreement gate

mas_uncert_check.what: complex-step Jacobian verified against central differences, linear vs Monte Carlo, MC precision gate, sensitivity table

mas_repro_check.what: same-seed bitwise equality, other-seed difference, SHA-256 digest, caller RNG restored

mas_ode_check.what: five ODE levels graded separately (solverExit/converged/errorTol/physicalInvariant/conclusion); analytic reference cross-checked against tight ode15s; invariant evaluated row by row; stiffness from the Jacobian eigenvalue ratio; a clean solver exit alone can never PASS; mas-ode-report/2 gives each scaling of the error its own name (maxAbs / maxScaled / maxSolverScaled / maxRel) with numerator, denominator, unit and aggregation stated

toolsNote: Generated from the files under skills/*/scripts. mas_capability_check.m fails when this drifts from disk, because a matrix that silently rots is worse than no matrix.
